rules.gold: the finished result of the item's IR on its runtime engine; ids are public (attack_id, CAPEC-<n>, CWE-<n>); stored_ids beside them
rules.dropped: empty gold (unless deliberately negative), incomplete/partial results, anchors not found, node answers over 300 ids, ranks whose ties exceed 25 ids, results holding ids with no public form, timeouts, duplicates
rules.negatives: deliberate negatives (verify false, empty sets) kept at or under 10%
rules.reduce: reduce='median' marks O2 applied to a groupby's values (zeros included): the IR holds the GroupBy, the gold value is the median of every member's value
rules.split: per (operator, dataset) stratum, ordered by sha256(id), alternating from the first hash's parity
